title: RetrievedChunk
description: Single hit returned by the shared semantic retriever search(query, top_k, max_tokens). Used identically by Method A and Method B.

chunk_id.description: Stable chunk identifier within an index build.

snapshot_sha.description: Pre-change snapshot commit SHA this chunk was indexed from.

symbol.description: Enclosing symbol when available; null otherwise.

text.description: Chunk text supplied as evidence (counts toward evidence budget).

content_hash.description: Hash of content for integrity and deduplication.

score.description: Cosine similarity score from the shared NumPy index.
